name: Nanaka
message: 「U-Um, hey... D-Do you remember? Actually, today's my birthday」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah...! You really did remember. Ahaha... That's kinda embarrassing」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh!? You even got me a present!? Y-You didn't have to do that...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-If you insist that much... I'll take it...」
